Move to the next designated location.desc: This action enables the uav to move from its current location to the next location if the two locations are connected. For example, the uav moves from location_1 to location_2 if location_1 and location_2 are connected.
Move to the next designated location.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to move from [position1] to [position2] if [position1] and [position2] are [state1].

Check if uav reach goal location.desc: This action enables a uav to mark it has reached the goal when it is at the goal location. For example, if location_2 is the goal location and the uav is currently at location_2, it can mark as having reached the goal.
Check if uav reach goal location.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to mark it has [state1] if the uav is at [position1] and [position1] is [state2].
